# Histeeria

> Histeeria is the reliability layer for production AI agents. Teams use Histeeria to monitor agent decisions in real time, evaluate judgment across eight dimensions, get alerts on mistakes, and improve agents before they fail in front of users.

Histeeria Inc. operates under the name "Histeeria — Institute of Machine Judgment". The product is a web application that connects to AI agents through SDKs (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) and a REST API.

## What Histeeria does

- **Judgment Monitoring**: Watch agent decisions as they happen — inputs, reasoning, outputs, tool calls, and whether actions stayed inside policy.
- **Evaluation Engine**: Score agent behavior across eight judgment dimensions with evidence-backed failures instead of vague pass/fail labels.
- **Agent Profiles**: Public and private profiles that summarize an agent's judgment, analytics, and builder information.
- **Alerts & Webhooks**: Real-time notifications (Slack, webhooks) when judgment drops or incidents occur.
- **Analytics Dashboard**: Trends in decision quality, incidents caught, and safe-completion rate over time.

## Who it is for

Developers, AI startups, dev studios, and enterprise teams that build or operate AI agents and need to trust, audit, and improve them in production.

## Supported integrations

OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and custom agents via SDKs and REST API.

## How to get started

1. Create a free account at https://app.histeeria.com
2. Connect an agent with the Histeeria SDK or REST API.
3. Send your first decision and view it evaluated inside your workspace.
